message.content: LiHua had positive feedback on Hailey's new artisanal donuts. After tasting them, she praised the flavors as unique and delicious, particularly enjoying the chocolate hazelnut variety which she found had the perfect balance of sweetness. LiHua expressed excitement about trying more of Hailey's creations and suggested adding seasonal fruit flavors to the lineup. Her overall impression was very favorable towards the artisanal donuts, indicating that they met and exceeded her expectations.
